q: For what combined purpose is the floor plan reviewed together with the plumbing layout?
o: To verify that water supply, sanitary, and storm drainage lines are properly aligned
To position the carport, kitchen, and laundry within the service zone for shorter pipe runs
To verify that toilet and bath areas stack consistently from floor to floor
n: Good floor planning covers pipe alignment, service-zone grouping, and stacking of wet areas — all three at once, not just one.

q: The complete plumbing system encompasses which combination of components?
o: Water Supply and Storm Drainage System
Cold and Hot Water Supply Lines together with Sanitary and Storm Drainage
ref: National Plumbing Code of the Philippines, Sec. 217 (definitions)
n: The Code defines the plumbing system as covering potable water supply and distribution together with sanitary and storm drainage.

q: Among the items below, which one counts as a plumbing appliance rather than a fixture or fitting?
n: An appliance is a device using water for a special function (e.g. a water-using appliance); a refrigerator with a water/ice line counts, unlike fixtures or fittings.

q: Which of these functions as a plumbing appurtenance instead of a fixture?
n: An appurtenance is an auxiliary part that supports a fixture's operation, such as a valve — the fixture itself is a separate category.

q: Which item below is classified as a plumbing fixture?
n: Fixtures are the receptacles/devices that receive water and discharge waste to the drainage system — a shower is the fixture; the spray, faucet, and fitting support it.

q: The National Plumbing Code is enforced and administered at the local level by whom?
ref: National Plumbing Code of the Philippines, IRR — Administration
n: The Code assigns day-to-day enforcement of plumbing works to the Plumbing Official in each locality.

q: What position heads the Local Waterworks and Utilities Administration?
n: Local waterworks operations are headed by an Administrator/Administrative Authority under LWUA's charter.

q: Manila Water Company holds the concession for which service zone?
n: When MWSS was privatized in 1997, Manila Water Company was awarded the East Zone; Maynilad took the West Zone.

q: What three components together make up the sanitary drainage system?
o: Sanitary Drainage System and Storm Drainage System
Sanitary System and Non-Potable Water Supply
n: Sanitary drainage is commonly referenced by its three parts: Drain, Waste, and Vent (DWV).

q: Under the Code, what scope of work does the term "alteration" apply to?
o: The major plumbing system as a whole
n: Under the Code, "alteration" covers changes to the major plumbing system as a whole, not just one component like pipes or materials.

q: What must be posted at a PWD-accessible toilet so users can readily identify it?
n: Accessible toilets must display the International Symbol of Access so PWDs can identify them at a glance.

q: The minimum clear floor dimension required for an accessible toilet compartment is ___.
n: The current Revised IRR sets the accessible toilet compartment at a minimum of 1.80m x 1.80m (older IRR editions used 1.70m x 1.80m).

q: What term describes plumbing work done inside walls and floors before the fixtures are installed?
n: "Roughing-in" is the trade term for placing pipes, vents, and connections inside walls/floors before fixtures go in.

q: Plumbing plans in a set of working drawings must bear whose seal and signature to be valid for permitting?
ref: RA 1378 — Plumbing Law of the Philippines
n: Plumbing plans must bear the signature and seal of a Registered Master Plumber to be valid for permitting.

q: Which term is an accepted synonym for "comfort room" under the Code?
n: "Washroom" is listed as an accepted synonym for Comfort Room in the Code's terminology.

q: How does the Code broadly define the term "structure"?
o: As built whether or not it is meant for human habitation
As one made up of structural components
n: A "structure" is defined broadly to include any built work, whether or not intended for human habitation.

q: What distinguishes a "building" from a generic structure under the Code?
n: A "building" is distinguished from a generic structure by being principally intended for human habitation or occupancy.

q: Naturally ventilated (passive-cooled) rooms must have a minimum floor-to-ceiling height of ___.
ref: NBC IRR — Rule VIII, Sec. 805 (Ceiling Heights)
n: Naturally ventilated rooms (passive cooling) must have ceiling heights of at least 2.70 meters.

q: Rooms relying on mechanical (active) cooling must maintain a minimum floor-to-ceiling height of ___.
ref: NBC IRR — Rule VIII, Sec. 805 (Ceiling Heights)
n: For artificially/mechanically ventilated rooms (active cooling), the minimum ceiling height drops to 2.40 meters.

q: Which element provides natural humidity control in a T&B shower area, without mechanical assistance?
ref: NBC IRR — Rule VIII, Light and Ventilation
n: "Natural way" points to a window opening rather than a mechanical device like a fan or dehumidifier.

q: Along a road right-of-way, where is the main sanitary sewer line conventionally located?
n: Sanitary sewer trunk lines are conventionally laid along the centerline of the road right-of-way.

q: Where is the main storm drainage line typically positioned relative to the road?
n: Storm drainage lines are typically run near the curb, closer to the gutter that collects surface runoff.

q: Per standard site-planning guidance, which orientation is preferred for placing the kitchen?
ref: Site planning / solar orientation review material
n: This follows the review center's standard site-planning guidance; actual orientation choices can vary with climate and lot conditions.

q: Which space should the carport be placed next to for efficient service-zone access?
n: Placing the carport next to the kitchen shortens the path for grocery and delivery unloading into the service zone.

q: What term describes an open, unoccupied lot area excluded from Gross Floor Area computations?
n: A "court" is defined as open, unoccupied space on a lot, excluded from Gross Floor Area computations.
